tree.heading: Term of loan
tree.text: In the case of each loan commodity (other than upland cotton or extra long staple cotton), a marketing assistance loan under section 7231 of this title shall have a term of 9 months beginning on the first day of the first month after the month in which the loan is made.

tree.heading: Special rule for cotton
tree.text: A marketing assistance loan for upland cotton or extra long staple cotton shall have a term of 10 months beginning on the first day of the month in which the loan is made.

tree.heading: Extensions prohibited
tree.text: The Secretary may not extend the term of a marketing assistance loan for any loan commodity.
